challenges.name: generic-report-helpers
challenges.title: Replace the copy-pasted report helpers with GroupBy, SumBy and SortedKeys
challenges.description: The reports team has a groupParcelsByDistrict, a groupDriversByShift, a sumCOD, a sumWeight and a sumStops, all copy-pasted and all slightly different. Write three generic functions instead: GroupBy groups items by a key function and keeps the input order inside each group, SumBy adds up a numeric value of every item (int, int64 or float64, and named types based on them), and SortedKeys returns the keys of a map in ascending order (string order, so q10 comes before q2). The test runner uses the same three functions on parcels (by district, summing COD in VND and weight in kg) and on drivers (by shift, summing stops).

tests.name: Parcels by district and drivers by shift
tests.input:
parcel SP-2001 q1 350000 1.5
parcel SP-2002 q3 120000 0.5
parcel SP-2003 q1 120000 1.5
driver an morning 12
driver bich morning 9
driver ha evening 7
tests.expected:
district q1: SP-2001 SP-2003 (470000 VND, 3.0 kg)
district q3: SP-2002 (120000 VND, 0.5 kg)
shift evening: ha (7 stops)
shift morning: an bich (21 stops)

parcel SP-2302 q10 2750000 4.5

driver bich morning 8
